claims.quote: We all remember now what that better aged care is all about—AI bots to make sure that poor old elderly Australians who are waiting for home care packages cannot get their policies considered properly. It's all being done by an AI bot.

claims.source_name: Labor backs down on 'irreversible' aged care algorithm
claims.source_notes: Speaker cites nothing. The system referred to is the Support at Home Integrated Assessment Tool (IAT); coverage the same day reports minister Sam Rae saying 'There is no artificial intelligence in our aged care assessment system'.
claims.vintage_rationale: An automated rules-based classification algorithm (the IAT) does set home-care funding levels and limits assessor overrides, but the government says it contains no AI and assessors still enter information, so 'all being done by an AI bot' overstates it.

claims.source_notes: The SDN says almost 70% of UK employment is in high-exposure occupations, roughly equally split between high and low complementarity.
